items.topSkuDominates: {sku} accounts for {pct}% of this month's cost. Worth checking if it can be reduced.
items.firestoreReads: Most of the cost goes to Firestore reads. Consider: using `get` instead of `onSnapshot` on stable data, adding Zustand caching, consolidating queries.
items.firestoreWrites: Firestore writes are expensive. Look at batch writes, debouncing frequently-updated fields, etc.
items.firestoreGeneric: Firestore is the main driver this month. Worth checking which queries fire most often via Performance Monitoring.
items.storageEgress: Cloud Storage egress (downloads) costs money. Consider a CDN with cache headers, or smaller image sizes (already done — verify thumbnails are used).
items.storageOps: Many class A/B operations on Storage. Check for loops causing unnecessary list operations.
items.functionsInvocations: Cloud Functions / Run cost per invocation and per execution time. Watch cold starts and runtime length.
items.messagingGeneric: FCM is sending many messages. Ensure no duplicates and that you aren't sending to dead tokens.
items.loggingVolume: Cloud Logging bills by volume. Consider lowering production log level or adding sampling.
items.spikeWarning: {sku} jumped {pct}% this month. Investigate what change caused it.
